svg.text: Open the app → Align camera (live check)
Read the panel at the bottom, then adjust:
Usable. Closer (fewer spacers) or window S + clip-on lens is better.
Move closer, or use window S with a clip-on macro lens.
Tap the tray on screen. Never sharp? Add a spacer (lens too close).
Slide the phone until a window is in view; check the light.
The yellow box is the area that will be measured.
The preview is coarser than the photo, so judge by the numbers.
